changes.title: Compute Engine: Feature (November 12, 2026)
changes.detail: Generally available : In a managed instance group (MIG) with instance flexibility, you can override the instance template's disk and minimum CPU platform properties per instance selection. Overriding these properties lets you combine machine types that require different disk types, boot images, or CPU platforms in a single MIG. For more information, see About instance flexibility in MIGs .
